description: Defines the QueryFilter class used for filtering display entities such as categories and search results, with properties for filter code, filter ID, and filter type.

classes.name: QueryFilter
classes.description: A data model used to specify filtering criteria for display entities based on code, ID, and type.

methods.name: getFilterCode
methods.description: Returns the filter code used for filtering.

methods.name: setFilterCode
methods.description: Sets the filter code used for filtering.

methods.name: getFilterId
methods.description: Returns the filter ID used for filtering.

methods.name: setFilterId
methods.description: Sets the filter ID used for filtering.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the type of filter applied.
